title: Doors — Fwd Cargo Door Latching — Corrosion-Resistant Hook Set
abstract: Cancelled retrofit of the corrosion-resistant steel latch hook set at the forward cargo door, withdrawn when the load-sharing carriage arrangement made the hook material change unnecessary as a standalone action.

sections.planning_reason: Eleven cases of a forward cargo door latch hook binding on its shaft were reported from tropical and coastal networks between 2014 and 2016, three of them preventing the door from closing. The cadmium plating on the original carbon steel hook breaks down at the bearing face and corrosion products build up in the running clearance. This Service Bulletin offered the corrosion-resistant hook set as an in-service answer.
sections.description: The eight latch hooks were to be replaced by corrosion-resistant steel items with a nitrided bearing face. The hook shaft bores in the forward latching intercostal were to be reamed 0.2 mm oversize and bushed, and the forward latching strap replaced by a thicker item to carry the bush seating.
sections.accomplishment_summary: The accomplishment instructions were withdrawn at revision 02 and are no longer valid. Operators who embodied this Service Bulletin before its cancellation are at the corrosion-resistant hook standard and may proceed directly to the load-sharing arrangement of Service Bulletin SLN-52-1043; no rework of the bushed bores is required. Operators who did not embody it should disregard it entirely and go to SLN-52-1043, whose accomplishment instructions cover the original hook standard as well.
sections.effectivity_note: Cancelled with effect from January 2021. The Service Bulletin was applicable to aircraft at the original latch hook standard, which is the majority of the pre-2021 fleet. It is replaced in full by Service Bulletin SLN-52-1043.
sections.material_note: Kit K5230-1024-01 is withdrawn and is no longer supplied. Operators holding unused kits may return them for credit until the end of the warranty period. Items already installed remain supported as spares.

revision_history.reason: Service Bulletin cancelled and replaced by SLN-52-1043; accomplishment instructions withdrawn
